s01_typing.text: Your laptop is rendering a video… and it's getting hot.

s02_thermal.text: Through a thermal camera, the heat comes from one spot. Right above the chip.

s04_diveB.text: Under this copper plate is the chip.

s07_electrons.text: Every time one switches, electrons are pushed through the silicon.

s08_bump.text: They bump into its atoms, and every bump turns a little electricity into heat.

s09_array.text: A render flips these switches billions of times a second.

s10_die.text: So almost all the power the chip uses… becomes heat.

s12_hotend.text: this copper pipe holds a little water. The chip turns it into vapour,

s13_vapour.text: the vapour rushes to the cold end,

s14_coldend.text: turns back into water, and soaks back through.

s15_fan.text: Then a fan blows air through thin metal fins,

s17_touch.text: That's why this side gets so hot.
